description: This file implements the remote OEM lock functionality for Android's hardware abstraction layer, including methods for getting the lock name, checking and setting OEM unlock permissions by carrier and device, and internal request handling.

classes.name: OemLock
classes.description: Class implementing OEM lock control functions, including permission checks and updates.

methods.name: resultToStatus
methods.description: Converts a Result<void> to a ScopedAStatus, mapping success and error states.

methods.name: OemLock::getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the OEM lock implementation.

methods.name: OemLock::setOemUnlockAllowedByCarrier
methods.description: Sets whether OEM unlock is allowed by carrier.

methods.name: OemLock::isOemUnlockAllowedByCarrier
methods.description: Checks if OEM unlock is allowed by carrier.

methods.name: OemLock::setOemUnlockAllowedByDevice
methods.description: Sets whether OEM unlock is allowed by device.

methods.name: OemLock::isOemUnlockAllowedByDevice
methods.description: Checks if OEM unlock is allowed by device.

methods.name: OemLock::requestValue
methods.description: Requests the value of a specific OEM lock field from the hardware channel.

methods.name: OemLock::setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specific OEM lock field via the hardware channel.
